description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named RelatedItemsController that manages related product functionality in an e-commerce admin panel. It provides endpoints for displaying, paginating, adding, and removing related product relationships, handling product data and interactions via AJAX, and performing authorization checks.

classes.name: RelatedItemsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller that manages related product relationships within the admin interface, providing endpoints for listing, adding, removing, and paginating related products, with security annotations for role-based access control.

methods.name: displayRelatedItems
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the related items page for a specific product identified by its ID, validating the product and store, then preparing the model with product and category data for the view.

methods.name: pageRelatedItems
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch related product relationships for a given product, returning data in JSON format suited for AJAX pagination, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a related product relationship between a base product and another product, with validation of product ownership and sending back success or failure status.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove an existing related product relationship, validating the relationship's existence and ownership, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: A private helper method to set menu-related attributes in the model for view rendering.
